description: On-field review: penalty awarded to France for Risdon's challenge on Griezmann (first ever World Cup on-field review); Griezmann scored, Risdon booked.
Penalty awarded to Peru after video review for Poulsen's foul on Cueva; Cueva missed. Note: REFSIX's text reverses the teams; Wikipedia's match report confirms Peru were awarded the penalty.
First on-field review for a potential red card: Prijovic (Serbia) raised hand to opponent's face; referee judged no violent conduct, yellow card only.
VAR alerted referee to a missed penalty; Sweden awarded penalty for foul on Claesson.
Factual VAR decision (no on-field review): free kick on the edge of the box for foul on Salah upgraded to a penalty as the foul continued into the area.
On-field review: penalty awarded to Australia for handball by Poulsen.
Mistaken identity correction: caution initially given to Flores (Peru) transferred to Aquino (Peru), who had fouled Fekir. No team advantage changed.
Penalty awarded to Brazil (Neymar shirt pull claim) overturned after on-field review.
On-field review: penalty to Iceland for Ebuehi's challenge on Finnbogason; Sigurdsson missed.
First rejected on-field review: referee reviewed his penalty award to Saudi Arabia (push on Al-Muwallad) and stuck with the original decision; penalty stood.
Aspas's late equaliser, initially flagged offside, awarded after VAR determined the offside call was incorrect (factual decision, no on-field review).
On-field review: penalty to Portugal for Ezatolahi's challenge on Ronaldo (Ronaldo's kick saved).
On-field review of potential red card for Ronaldo's arm on Pouraliganji; referee issued yellow card only.
On-field review: penalty to Iran for handball by Cedric Soares; Iran equalised from the spot.
On-field review of possible Rojo handball in his own area (Nigeria appeal); referee Cakir stuck with no penalty.
Kim Young-gwon's stoppage-time goal, flagged offside, awarded after review determined Kroos (Germany) played the ball.
On-field review of possible Hernandez handball (Sweden penalty appeal); referee Pitana stuck with no penalty.
Penalty awarded to Costa Rica overturned: Ruiz was offside when he received the ball (factual decision, no on-field review).
Penalty awarded to Senegal (challenge on Mane) overturned after on-field review: Sanchez played the ball.
R16: penalty to Sweden changed to a free kick after on-field review (Lang's foul on Olsson occurred outside the box); Lang's red card for DOGSO stood.
Final: on-field review for Perisic handball after a corner; penalty awarded, Griezmann scored to make it 2-1.
Valencia's early goal for Ecuador ruled out for offside via semi-automated offside technology.
Penalty to Iran for foul by Stones on Pouraliganji after VAR review; Taremi scored.
VAR review: penalty to Argentina for Abdulhamid holding Paredes at a corner; Messi scored.
Lautaro Martinez's 27th-minute goal disallowed for offside via semi-automated offside technology (shoulder ahead of last defender).
VAR review: penalty to Poland for foul by Moreno on Lewandowski; Ochoa saved.
Rejected on-field review: VAR advised penalty to Denmark for Meriah handball; referee Ramos instead penalised a prior foul by Jensen (Denmark) and gave Tunisia a free kick.
Havertz goal disallowed for offside after VAR review.
VAR review: penalty to Canada for handball by Carrasco; Davies's kick saved by Courtois.
On-field review: Wales goalkeeper Hennessey's challenge upgraded to a straight red card (only VAR red card of the tournament).
Gholizadeh goal for Iran disallowed for offside after VAR review.
VAR review: penalty to Saudi Arabia for foul by Bielik on Al-Shehri; Al-Dawsari's kick saved by Szczesny.
Ziyech free-kick goal disallowed: Saiss offside in front of the goalkeeper.
Rudiger goal disallowed for offside after VAR review.
Aboubakar goal awarded after incorrect offside flag was overturned by VAR.
Vinicius Junior goal disallowed: Richarlison offside in the build-up.
VAR review: penalty to Portugal for handball by Gimenez; Bruno Fernandes scored.
Berghuis goal disallowed for handball by Gakpo in the build-up.
On-field review: penalty to Argentina for Szczesny's glove contact on Messi's face; Szczesny saved Messi's kick. ESPN judged the intervention unnecessary.
Griezmann's 98th-minute equaliser disallowed for offside after VAR review (played after full-time whistle sequence; ESPN questioned the process).
Penalty awarded to Croatia (Carrasco on Kramaric) cancelled after on-field review for a marginal offside against Lovren in the build-up.
Tanaka's winner allowed after VAR review: ball ruled (by millimetres) not to have fully crossed the byline before Mitoma's cutback.
Fullkrug goal awarded after incorrect offside flag was overturned by VAR.
VAR review: offside flag against Andre Ayew invalidated (played onside), opening review of Rochet's collision with Kudus; penalty to Ghana, Andre Ayew's kick saved.
Rejected on-field review: VAR advised penalty review for Amartey's challenge on Nunez; referee Siebert stuck with no penalty.
R16: VAR review awarded Poland a stoppage-time penalty for handball by Upamecano.
R16: Lewandowski's penalty was saved by Lloris, but VAR ordered a retake because Lloris was off his line; Lewandowski converted the retake.
QF: VAR review awarded England an 84th-minute penalty for Theo Hernandez's push on Mount; Kane shot over the bar.
8': Chaibi (Algeria) goal ruled out after VAR review (ESPN feed; ground for overturn not stated in feed).
67': Arnautovic (Austria) goal ruled out after VAR review (ESPN feed).
90+2': Ferran Torres (Spain) goal ruled out after VAR review (ESPN feed).
25': Taremi (Iran) goal ruled out for offside after VAR check (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
29': G'aniev (Uzbekistan) goal ruled out after VAR review (ESPN feed).
22': Vinicius Junior (Brazil) goal ruled out after VAR review (ESPN feed).
90+3': Khalilzadeh (Iran) stoppage-time goal ruled out for offside after VAR review (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
17': Mbuku (DR Congo) goal disallowed after VAR review for a foul in the build-up (Mbuku caught Nasrullaev with his hand; ESPN VAR review column).
R32, 102' (extra time): Tah (Germany) goal disallowed after on-field review for a foul by Anton on Paraguay goalkeeper Gill (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
R32, 90+13': Gvardiol (Croatia) goal ruled out (offside per ESPN VAR review column) after VAR review.

R16, 58' (feed) / 62' (ESPN column): Mostafa Zico's goal that would have put Egypt 2-0 up disallowed after on-field review for a foul by Attia on Lisandro Martinez (shirt hold + stepping on foot) at the start of the counter. ESPN's VAR expert called it 'probably an intervention too far'. Argentina came back to win 3-2.
QF, 55': Heggem (Norway) goal ruled out after VAR review for a foul by Haaland on Anderson in the build-up (ESPN feed; Wikipedia/BBC).
84': Svanberg (Sweden) goal awarded after VAR review using Connected Ball Tracking technology overturned the on-field offside/no-goal decision (ESPN VAR review column).
43': Freeman (USA) header awarded following VAR review after an on-field offside decision (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
73': Luckassen (Ghana) equaliser awarded after VAR review (ESPN feed: 'VAR Decision: Goal Croatia 1-1 Ghana').
90+10': VAR decision: penalty to Austria for handball by Obaid; Arnautovic converted (ESPN feed).
7': VAR decision: penalty to Argentina; Messi's kick missed to the right at 9' (ESPN feed).
29': VAR decision: penalty to Argentina; Lautaro Martinez converted for 2-0 (ESPN feed).
R32, extra time: penalty to Belgium (Camara foul on Tielemans, 117') confirmed after the referee was called to the monitor by VAR; Tielemans converted for 3-2 (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
R32, 64'-65': penalty to Portugal (Vlasic foul on Veiga) with 'VAR Decision: Penalty Portugal' logged; Ronaldo converted (ESPN feed).
R16, 67': VAR intervention (on-field review) awarded France a penalty; Mbappe converted (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
R16, 10'-12': penalty to Brazil (Ajer foul on Cunha) with 'VAR Decision: Penalty Brazil' logged; Bruno Guimaraes's kick saved by Nyland (ESPN feed).
R16, 66'-68': VAR review awarded Mexico a penalty for Kane's foul on Gutierrez; Jimenez converted (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).

33': on-field penalty to Canada changed to a free kick after VAR review (offence outside the area); Qatar's El Amin was sent off on the same review (see red_card_issued row) (ESPN feed: 'VAR Decision: No Penalty Canada'; ESPN VAR review column).
82'-84': Zwane (South Africa) card upgraded to red for violent conduct (hand caught Alvarado's face) after VAR review; ESPN's reviewer called it harsh (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
33': El Amin (Qatar) sent off (DOGSO) on the same VAR review that changed Canada's penalty to a free kick (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).
51'-53': Madibo (Qatar) card upgraded to red on VAR review (ESPN feed: 'VAR Decision: Card upgraded Assim Madibo'; ESPN VAR review column: sent off on review).

45+2'-45+3': Almiron (Paraguay) sent off after a quick VAR review for covering his mouth while speaking confrontationally to an opponent (new IFAB rule); ESPN feed logged 'VAR Decision: No card change' before the red was shown (ESPN VAR review column).
12'-13': Sulaka (Iraq) card upgraded to red after VAR review (ESPN feed).
R32, 90+5': Hincapie (Ecuador) card upgraded to red after VAR review (ESPN feed).

R32, 63'-64': Balogun (USA) card upgraded to red for serious foul play after on-field review (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column). FIFA later upheld the suspension appeal drama covered separately in media.
R16, 53'-54': Quansah (England) card upgraded to red for serious foul play after on-field review (ESPN feed; ESPN VAR review column).

QF, 70'-72': after VAR review, Paredes's (Argentina) yellow for a challenge on Embolo was rescinded and Embolo (Switzerland) was booked for simulation instead - his second yellow, so he was sent off. Second use of the new 'mistaken identity' protocol at this World Cup (ESPN VAR review column; Wikipedia).

52': mistaken-identity card change after VAR review: Ream's (USA) yellow rescinded and given to Almiron (Paraguay), who was deemed to have dived (ESPN feed: 'VAR Decision: Card Changed'; ESPN VAR review column).

9'-15': Kane's on-field penalty (checked and cleared by VAR) was saved by Livakovic, but VAR ordered a retake for encroachment by Livakovic and Gvardiol; Kane converted the retake. Feed logged two 'VAR Decision: Other Decision Cancelled' entries at 11' and 15' (ESPN VAR review column).

60'-62': VAR recommended an on-field review for a possible France penalty (Mane's lunge on Mbappe); referee Faghani stuck with no penalty. ESPN's reviewer strongly disagreed with the on-field call standing (ESPN feed: 'VAR Decision: No Penalty France'; ESPN VAR review column).
47': 'VAR Decision: No Penalty Germany' logged - review concluded no penalty for Germany (ESPN feed; no further detail in feed).
21': 'VAR Decision: No Penalty Belgium' logged - review concluded no penalty for Belgium (ESPN feed; no further detail in feed).
QF, 101' (extra time): 'VAR Decision: No Penalty England' logged - review concluded no penalty for England (ESPN feed).
